result_text:
`all_files.zip` now looks up and names its entries from the configured aspect names, so renaming `buildAndDeployment` no longer breaks the export. Nothing is committed.

The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`:

- The five hardcoded `aspect_*.txt` entries are replaced with calls to a new private helper, `getAspectFileListZipEntry(aspect)`. The helper derives the file name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that writes the loose text file, and reads that file. The order stays main, test, generated, build and deployment, other.
- The helper is placed just above `getTextDataFolder()`.

With the default config the entries are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, and `git-history.zip` is written again because the exception that used to skip it no longer fires.

I did not run an end-to-end export with a renamed aspect, and the module has no exporter test for this path. The module compiles and the existing `ReportFileExporterTest` passes (`mvn -o -pl reports test`).
